metadata.average: Current PDHG iterate within each epoch. At restart, replace it with the mean of the current epoch new iterates, excluding the epoch anchor, as in Applegate et al. Algorithm 1. epochAverage stores the mean separately.
metadata.halpern: Reflected Halpern, Lu & Yang Eq. 26 / Algorithm 2. Adaptive Eq. 10 with the PDHG canonical norm and a separately counted T reset.
metadata.counting: k counts PDHG operator evaluations for every method, including the Halpern reset. Equal operator counts, not a runtime benchmark.
metadata.restartPolicy: Adaptive. Average: Applegate Eq. 30, Euclidean normalized gap, beta=1/e, first epoch t>=1. Reflected Halpern: Lu & Yang Eq. 10, canonical fixed-point residual, beta=1/e, first epoch k>1. Checked each evaluation, not the production solver heuristics.
metadata.provenance: Independent deterministic calculation on min_x max_y xy. No parameter selection to obtain a visual advantage.
